description: Open the six narrowly scoped GitHub issues on halqavoice-club/HALQA1 (the original PROMPT-0 deliverable): Issue 1 P1 recovery runbook, Issue 2 P2 trigger idempotency migration, Issue 3 P2 database default reconciliation, Issue 4 P2 Prisma default integration test, Issue 5 P2 HTTP 409 handling, Issue 6 P2 raw-SQL test helper hygiene. Pre-flight already done during planning: no existing open or closed issue covers any of the six topics (searched 'microphone', 'runbook', 'idempotency', '20261030', '409', 'default' — only unrelated issues 106 and 154). The six issues will be implemented by FEAT-002..FEAT-006, so issue bodies should describe the work (context, problem, scope, acceptance criteria, verification plan) using existing file paths only.
steps: Read .agents/pipeline/2026-11-21_00-53-25/01-requirements.md (FR/AC per issue) and 02-design.md (Issue sections) as the body source.

Draft six issue bodies as files under .agents/pipeline/2026-11-21_00-53-25/task-20261030-migration-safety/issue-bodies/ (issue-1.md … issue-6.md). Each body: Context, Problem, Scope (affected paths that exist at HEAD: backend/prisma/migrations/20261030_fix_live_class_microphone_triggers/migration.sql, backend/src/controllers/live-class.controller.js, backend/src/tests/integration/live-class.integration.test.js, backend/src/tests/live-class-real-db.test.js, backend/fix-live-class-columns.js, backend/prisma/schema.prisma), Acceptance criteria (copy FR/AC numbering from requirements), Verification plan, Related issues (fill after creation: cross-reference Issue 2 <-> Issue 3, Issue 3 <-> Issue 6).

Issue 2 body must include the immutable reference checksum line: 'SHA-256 of 20261030_fix_live_class_microphone_triggers/migration.sql at main e15dad23a8333667f895d4e3649f0f47bd3696c6 = 4fc783645ef9efbe181412e5abe32f3174a746ab9e1d585209ce26408c71cc80; the PR reviewer re-runs (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256) on the final branch and confirms it matches.'

Issue 3 body must state: align the DB column default to SFU_AUTHORITATIVE (schema.prisma @default already SFU_AUTHORITATIVE; production create path rawCreateLiveClass always sets the value explicitly); existing row values must not be rewritten; dependency on Issue 2 (stable trigger state) and Issue 6 (helpers no longer depend on LEGACY default).

Create the issues (title format: '[P1] Document Migration 20261030 production recovery runbook', '[P2] Harden the microphone trigger migration against re-execution', '[P2] Reconcile the database microphone authorization default', '[P2] Add an isolated Prisma default-behavior integration test', '[P2] Return HTTP 409 for microphone trigger authorization rejection', '[P2] Make microphone trigger test helpers explicit'): gh issue create -R halqavoice-club/HALQA1 --title '<title>' --body-file <body file> --label documentation (Issue 1) / --label enhancement (Issues 2-6).
After creation, edit Issue 3 and Issue 2 bodies (gh issue edit <n> -R halqavoice-club/HALQA1 --body-file …) to add the cross-references #<n> once numbers are known.
Write the final report table (Action / Result / Issue number / URL) into findings.
acceptance_criteria: Six issues exist open on halqavoice-club/HALQA1, one per topic, with priority in the title and a documentation/enhancement label.

Issue 3 body states the SFU_AUTHORITATIVE direction decision and its dependencies on Issues 2 and 6.

gh issue view <n> -R halqavoice-club/HALQA1 for each confirms the body renders the required sections.
gh issue list -R halqavoice-club/HALQA1 --state all --search '20261030' shows no duplicate pre-dating this feature.
